title: lathyrus brachycalyx var. zionis
intro: Lathyrus brachycalyx var. zionis, commonly known as Zion's peavine or Zion's pea, is a plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which may include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus brachycalyx var. zionis are believed to be due to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant may include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, although further research is needed to confirm their specific effects.
